label: First two input steps on h/c/b/f/z/0/1, plus the copy phase of length-3 sequences
explanation: Two regimes. (1) Most of the firing (about 73% of mass): small activations at original steps t=0..2, mostly t<=1, and strongly dependent on the input token. h, c, b, f, z, 0 and 1 fire at 3-4x the base rate, and e fires on some steps. It is almost never active at original steps t>=3. (2) Rare but the largest activations (about 27% of mass, all of the top examples): the copy phase of L=3 sequences, mainly at recall_idx 1 (step 4) when the first original token is fed back in. There it reaches near max, and the input token again sets the magnitude (h, e, c, b, f near the top). It never fires on the delimiter step or on copy steps of sequences with L>=4. Misses are mostly t=1 or t=2 steps with other tokens (e, l, v) where firing is weak and depends on context. False positives are listed tokens at t=1 that do not cross threshold.
